verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a general data-residency/region-selection feature for Neon's core Postgres storage; the only region-specific detail is that the AI Gateway (a bolt-on LLM proxy) is currently limited to two AWS regions in beta, which does not address database/data residency choice. missing for 10: no docs on selecting a home region for the Postgres project/branches, no residency/compliance statements, no evidence of region choice at project creation.
